summary: This March 25, 2025 Dante lecture gives the lens an earlier Renaissance ignition source: Dante breaks Augustine's obedience world by making free will God's gift, love the maturity of intellect, imagination a world-making power, and vernacular poetry the quiet force that lets modernity grow inside Christianity.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Beatrice says intellect must mature in the flame of love, and Jiang glosses love as the light in humans that gains empathy, imagination, and wisdom.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Love Recognizes The Other child already uses this source in the durable heart-love anchor; the impact record closes the accounting for that public evidence.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the harder Dante teaching layer where love does not replace reason but lets intellect mature into empathy, imagination, wisdom, remorse, and growth.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Love Recognizes owns the relational-love and recognition mechanism. Human Heart owns the broader civilizational measure; Free Will owns choice as burden; Poetry owns medium and transmission.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source in a future replacement pass as an earlier Dante free-will formulation: humans are of God but free of God, and God's highest gift is the freedom to choose one's life rather than servile obedience.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns this when the active mechanism is choice as divine burden. Love Recognizes owns the same source when love matures intellect; Eschatology owns hell, salvation, and role-script material only when final-destination structure is primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this 2025 lecture as the earlier constructive Dante layer before the 2026 darker Dante/Virgil lecture: vernacular poetry democratizes sacred access, makes the poet a hero of the journey, supplies the spark that conditions alone cannot create, and quietly remakes the empire from within.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the civilizational medium, vernacular access, and poetic spark. Fictional Heroes owns Dante only when the active mechanism is a literary person becoming interior authority; Guide Trap owns the later Virgil-as-danger sequence.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Renaissance art passages as supporting story-control evidence: art changes from command and submission to participation, investigation, and viewer imagination, so the audience helps make the scene alive.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Stories owns participation as reality-making when a form trains the viewer to inhabit and complete a scene. Poetry owns the specific poetic medium; Dead World and Attention own imagination capture when the screen becomes a prison.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the Renaissance-as-recombination frame as civilizational evidence only if that page is being revised: open cooperative competition, city-state participation, merchant legitimacy, printing, art, and Dante's spark form a new inner order rather than a simple technological or economic story.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization owns the whole-form recombination. Legitimacy Fiction owns merchant patronage only when the question is right-to-rule; Bureaucracy owns imperial observer paralysis; Borderland owns the city-state participation environment if the frontier/decentralization mechanism is primary.

new_lens_seeds.title: Poetic Ignition Of Modernity
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Historical conditions can gather fuel, but a poetic reinterpretation can supply the spark by changing what humans are allowed to imagine themselves to be.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The phrase captures Jiang's Dante thesis and may recur wherever a poem, sacred story, or literary world changes a civilization's self-permission. For now it belongs as routing pressure inside Poetry, Civilization, Stories, Love, and Free Will rather than a public standalone page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create a standalone Dante, Renaissance, Humanism, Poetic Modernity, or God-Is-Love page from this source alone; route by active mechanism until cross-source pressure requires a child.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-03-25, this is an earlier constructive Dante formulation than the April 8, 2026 Dante/Virgil source currently prominent on Poetry, Stories, Fictional Heroes, Guide Trap, and Eschatology. Future Dante work should preserve the sequence: first Dante as love/free-will/imagination ignition, later Dante as anti-Virgil guide-trap and hell-choice diagnosis.

The lecture's theology sequence moves from Paul, Tertullian, Origen, and Augustine through Aquinas toward Dante; use it as dated source support when explaining why Jiang treats Dante as a successful break from obedience rather than just another Renaissance author.

This source gives an explicit literacy chronology: Dante's Tuscan vernacular is paired with Greek alphabetic literacy as a democratizing revolution, which can pressure future Poetry or Living School chronology if a public pass needs earlier access-language support.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose is needed: Love Recognizes and Human Heart already cite this source, and the main value of this intake is to preserve Dante chronology and route future public edits away from duplicate standalone pages.

If a future Poetry replacement pass happens, add this source as the earlier constructive Dante layer before the existing April 2026 invasion/guide-trap layer, preferably by replacing weaker prose rather than expanding the page.

Do not create standalone Dante, Renaissance, Humanism, Free Will From God, God Is Love, Love Teaches God, Augustine's Air, or Poetic Ignition pages from this source alone; route the pressure to Love Recognizes, Free Will, Poetry, Stories, Civilization, Human Heart, and Guide Trap by active mechanism.
